ActorTalk: Did you see anyone suspicious around here, Commandant?
Based on that strange signal earlier, we're definitely after the same target.
Dahei, did you see anyone suspicious?
I... I think so, but it disappeared into the crowd instantly...
So... what exactly is going on?
Ahhh... nope. Still don't get it.
Let me explain! The Engineering Force was testing a batch of civilian helper AI Kuroros.
Someone tampered with their data... and the whole batch ran away.
Now they're disguised as humans and scattered across four areas: Dreamglow Gardens, Logistics Center, Babylonia Universal Cinema, and Olympia Art Gallery.
That's the situation. I still have to track down whoever hacked the Engineering Force's network, so we're a bit short-handed right now.
Commandant, can you lend the Engineering Force a hand? With this updated camera, you can spot Kuroros hiding among the crowd.
And as for your reward... once the job's done, I'll grant you one request!
